# ADR 0002: Double-entry journals with immutable postings

← [Architecture](../README.md) · [Capstone brief](../../README.md)

- **Status:** Accepted
- **Capstone:** Core banking ledger

## Context

Balances must be explainable to auditors and regulators, and errors must be correctable without losing history.

## Decision

Model every money movement as a journal whose postings sum to zero per currency. Never update or delete postings; correct with reversing journals. Enforce immutability with a trigger and balance with a deferred constraint trigger.

## Consequences

Full audit trail and a provable trial balance; corrections are visible. Storage grows with activity (acceptable; archive later).

## Alternatives considered

Single-entry balance updates with an audit log (easy to drift and hard to prove).
